window.title: Window
window.description: Colors used across the whole window.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Playlist panel, dialogs, inputs and badges.

textMuted.title: Secondary text
textMuted.description: Less important text: hints, times, counts.

border.title: Borders
border.description: Lines around panels, buttons, inputs and dialogs.

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: Primary buttons, switched-on toggles and slider handles.

accentText.title: Text on accent
accentText.description: Text and icons on accent-colored buttons.

buttonHover.title: Button under the mouse
buttonHover.description: Background of a button while the pointer is over it.

buttonText.title: Button text
buttonText.description: Text and icons on ordinary buttons.

badgesBackground.title: Playlist badge column
badgesBackground.description: Background of the narrow column with the round playlist badges.

badgeActiveBorder.title: Selected badge outline
badgeActiveBorder.description: Ring around the selected playlist badge.

controlsText.title: Control bar text
controlsText.description: Text and icons in the control bar.

progressTrack.title: Progress track
progressTrack.description: The empty part of progress bars.

progressBar.title: Progress bar
progressBar.description: The filled part of progress bars.

progressBarEnd.title: Progress bar gradient end
progressBarEnd.description: The far end of the progress bars' gradient. Set it equal to the progress bar color for a flat bar.

overlayBackground.title: Message over the video
overlayBackground.description: Background of messages shown over the picture, such as playback errors.

overlayText.title: Text over the video
overlayText.description: Text color of messages over the picture.

trackCurrent.title: Playing track
trackCurrent.description: Highlight of the track that is playing.

trackHover.title: Track under the mouse
trackHover.description: Background of a track row while the pointer is over it.

rowSelected.title: Selected list row
rowSelected.description: Background of the selected playlist in the manager.

thumbBackground.title: Preview background
thumbBackground.description: Background behind preview images while they load.

dropIndicator.title: Reorder line
dropIndicator.description: Line showing where a dragged track will land.

dropHintBackground.title: Drop hint
dropHintBackground.description: Overlay shown while files are dragged over the window.

errorText.title: Error text
errorText.description: Error messages and destructive menu entries.

warningText.title: Warning text
warningText.description: Warnings, such as a video without its audio file.

dangerBackground.title: Danger button
dangerBackground.description: Background of buttons that delete things.

dangerBorder.title: Danger button outline
dangerBorder.description: Outline of buttons that delete things.

volumeUp.title: Volume high
volumeUp.description: Volume slider with a high volume.

volumeDown.title: Volume low
volumeDown.description: Volume slider with a low volume.

capturePreview.title: Use frame as preview
capturePreview.description: Save the current frame as the video's preview.

more.title: More actions
more.description: Open the menu of a track.

panelHideLeft.title: Hide panel (panel on the left)
panelHideLeft.description: Tab that hides the playlist panel when it is on the left.

panelShowLeft.title: Show panel (panel on the left)
panelShowLeft.description: Tab that shows the playlist panel when it is on the left.

panelHideRight.title: Hide panel (panel on the right)
panelHideRight.description: Tab that hides the playlist panel when it is on the right.

panelShowRight.title: Show panel (panel on the right)
panelShowRight.description: Tab that shows the playlist panel when it is on the right.

titleBar.title: System title bar
titleBar.description: Floating window style only. On keeps the operating system's title bar and window buttons (and then the transparent margin, rounded window corners and window shadow are not used). Off removes them.

resizable.title: Resizable window
resizable.description: Floating window style only. On lets you resize the window by its edges; off keeps its size, except in full screen.

cornerRadius.title: Window corner radius
cornerRadius.description: How round the corners of the window are.

shadowSize.title: Window shadow
shadowSize.description: Size of the shadow around the window (it also sets the transparent margin that holds it). 0 means no shadow.

windowOpacity.title: Window opacity
windowOpacity.description: How solid the window background behind the video is. Lower values let the desktop show through.

panelRadius.title: Panel corner radius
panelRadius.description: How round the corners of the control bar, playlist and dialogs are.

panelOpacity.title: Panel opacity
panelOpacity.description: How solid the control bar, playlist and dialogs are. Lower values make them see-through.

panelBlur.title: Panel blur
panelBlur.description: Frosted-glass blur behind the control bar, playlist and dialogs (best together with a lower panel opacity).

panelBorder.title: Panel border
panelBorder.description: Width of the colored line around the control bar, playlist and dialogs (uses the Borders color). 0 means no line.

panelGlow.title: Panel glow
panelGlow.description: Glow around the panels, tinted with the accent color. 0 means no glow.

progressGlow.title: Progress glow
progressGlow.description: Glow around the progress bars and the position slider, tinted with the gradient end color. 0 means no glow.

progressGloss.title: Progress gloss
progressGloss.description: Glossy, metallic look of the progress bars and the position slider: a bright highlight on top, a darker lower edge, and a sunken track. 0 means flat.

controlsGap.title: Control bar distance
controlsGap.description: Space between the control bar and the window edges.

playlistGap.title: Playlist distance
playlistGap.description: Space between the playlist cards and the window edges.

textGlow.title: Text glow
textGlow.description: Glow around all text, like a lit screen. 0 means none.

scanlines.title: Scanlines
scanlines.description: Dark horizontal lines over the whole window, like an old CRT screen. 0 means none.

monospace.title: Monospace font
monospace.description: Use a monospace (terminal) font for all text.
